classification.difficultyReason: Composite shapes need a decision between adding and subtracting rectangles. Part a subtracts the 4p×2q cut-out from 9p×6q. Part b needs the missing height 5h−2h, then a split into two rectangles, then like terms. This is the same demand as the reference.

content.prompt: Write a simplified expression for the area of the following composite shapes.

answer.worked:
Subtract the cut-out from the full rectangle.
$$\begin{align*}A&=(9p)(6q)-(4p)(2q)\\A&=54pq-8pq\\A&=46pq\end{align*}$$

The upper section has height $5h-2h=3h$ and width $3k$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=(8k)(2h)+(3k)(3h)\\A&=16hk+9hk\\A&=25hk\end{align*}$$
